title: A New Bean Row

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Do you remember the very first day we met? We planted a row of beans, right here.

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: It's spring again, and you've grown so much! Shall we plant a new row? A longer one, this time.

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Put a peg one stick away from the stone. Then one stick away from that peg, and so on. Lay the stick down to measure.
steps.hint: Lay the stick next to the stone. Where does the other end reach? Put a peg there.

feedback.placed_all: Now let's check with the stick. Does it fit each space?
feedback.crowded: Look: the stick covers a peg there. Those beans would be too close. Can that peg move further away?
feedback.far: Look: there's a gap past the end of the stick. Can that peg move closer?
feedback.all_good: Every space is one stick long. Just like last spring, but a longer row!

older.prompt: Four seeds in each hole this year. No dips to help: count them yourself.
older.hint: Count as you drop them in: one, two, three, four. Then the next hole.

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Now three seeds in each hole. Count as you drop them in: one, two, three.
steps.hint: Find a hole with an empty little dip and put a seed there.

feedback.full: That hole already has three seeds. Try a hole with an empty dip.
feedback.all_good: Every hole has its seeds. A whole new row, ready to grow!

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: A whole new row. Last spring you'd never planted a seed, and look at you now!

journal_line: I planted a new row of beans with Miss Miriam, one year after my first.
